      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Edits to cmake/secp256k1.cmake and secp256k1 build scripts are mechanical consequences of bundling experimental libsecp256k1 modules rather than improvements to Bitcoin Core's build or CI system."
    },
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Documentation updates under doc/descriptors.md and doc/psbt.md accompany the code changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Doc updates describe newly added CISA descriptor and PSBT fields, which belong to wallet and consensus rather than being a standalone documentation change."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touched src/kernel/chainparams.cpp only to register deployment parameters.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Editing chainparams does not touch the kernel API or library boundaries."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/policy/policy.cpp and src/policy/policy.h to specify standardness rules for CISA witness v2 transactions.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Defines standardness policy for witness v2 transactions and aggregated signatures, which is necessary for relaying and accepting CISA transactions in the mempool."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touched test/functional/mining_basic.py only as a mechanical test update.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "The PR does not modify block template generation, assembly algorithms, or the mining interface."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in test/functional/p2p_segwit.py are test adjustments.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "The PR does not alter p2p network protocols, transport, or peer message relay."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Exposes CISA descriptors and raw transaction decode support via existing RPC endpoints.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "The RPC changes merely expose the underlying script, descriptor, and PSBT capabilities rather than introducing new RPC infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Adds test_framework/cisa.py and test vectors specific to BIP460.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "The test additions and framework helpers test the specific CISA consensus, policy, and wallet behaviors, rather than test runner or harness infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Vendors unmerged experimental modules into the src/secp256k1 subtree.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Imports half-aggregation and full-aggregation cryptographic modules into the vendored secp256k1 subtree to support signature aggregation verification and signing."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Implements consensus script verification in src/script/interpreter.cpp and check queue batch validation in src/validation.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Serves as the reference implementation for BIP460 witness v2 consensus rules, allowing reviewers and specification authors to evaluate the consensus logic and batch verification behavior against test vectors."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds descriptor expressions, PSBT fields, and signing logic across src/wallet/ and src/script/descriptor.cpp.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Implements wallet signing and descriptor support (cisa(), rawcisa()) using half- and full-aggregation, providing an end-to-end prototype for multi-input fee savings in wallets."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 1,
    "user_value": 2,
    "leverage": 2
  }
}
